messages:
elliot: heads-up  token-cost card is showing negative cache savings for tenant `beta-co` after we ramped sticky routing on a canary. attached CSV excerpt.
parul: thanks. my first guess is sampling + phase mixing. can you paste the aggregator SQL?
elliot: current rollup we use: \n```
SELECT tenant, SUM(token_cost) AS cost, SUM(prefetch_credit) AS credits
FROM econ_invocations_sample
WHERE sample = true AND day = '2026-03-23'
GROUP BY tenant
```
sam: yepthat drops route_phase and doesn't scale sampled rows by 1/sample_rate. also the frontend still applies a routing_adjust after the rollup, so we might be double-adjusting.
parul: immediate mitigation: show a confidence pill on the card: "Estimated (10% sample) +/- 20%" and hide the sparkline when daily_invocations < 20 to reduce noise.
ops-bot: created ticket ECO-912: preserve route_phase in econ rollups and emit scaled fields (scaled_cost, scaled_credit, sample_rate). CI job: https://ci.internal/ECO-912
parul: plan: ETL change to emit scaled_cost, scaled_prefetch_credit, sample_rate and credit_source(route_phase). add regression test with synthetic small-tenant traces at sample_rate=0.1 to catch negative-savings.
sam: frontend follow-up: stop applying post-rollup routing multipliers; consume scaled_* directly and add a raw/scaled toggle for debugging. I'll own the UI PR.
elliot: assign and timeline: ETL PR (parul) + UI PR (sam) targeted EOW. watch econ-sentinel for 48h after deploy and post to #eng-oncall if triggered. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
